payload.text: The Crown's case on the listed condition rests on the attributed accounts in E-001 and E-002, both admitted for assessment of the fictional blue-token receipt and both remaining disputed. E-001 records Mira's statement that Fictional Morgan handed the blue token to Fictional Ellis at the desk. E-002 records Tavi's statement that no handover was seen and that Fictional Morgan left with the token. The Crown acknowledges the burden of proof beyond a reasonable doubt rests with the Crown on this fictional condition and does not invite the jury to treat the disputed attribution as established fact. The Crown asks only that the permitted accounts be assessed as the record permits.
